scope: Narrow Storage signing permission-probe compatibility fix
production_observation_source: Parent agent authenticated Supabase function, Storage and PostgreSQL logs

observed_failure.cause: The rollback-only signing INSERT has no user_metadata, while the trigger previously required the actual upload provenance and hash.

probe_requirements: version is the literal1 probe marker
metadata and user_metadata are absent or empty JSON objects
Canonical output path identifies the exact owner, session, clip and current lease
The current leased job passes the existing clip_check_job source, Auth-session, copyright and admission checks
The asset is one of the requested clip formats or valid thumbnail/captions
unchanged_boundaries: Actual uploads still require clip/job/lease provenance and a64-character lowercase SHA-256
UPDATE cannot use the signing-probe exception
Normal current-lease, source-rights, owner binding and asset-format checks remain
No new table, Storage privilege, RLS policy or runtime gate
No Edge Function or renderer image change
Completion still verifies actual Storage object metadata and manifest

primary_source_evidence.finding: allow_only_operation performs exact normalized matching and returns false when the current operation or requested name is absent.
SIGN_UPLOAD_URL is storage.object.sign_upload_url; the actual signed upload uses the distinct storage.object.upload_signed operation.
signUploadObjectUrl invokes uploader.canUpload before issuing the upload capability; metadata is optional.
authorizeUpload constructs version1 with optional metadata and userMetadata, then attempts the object write through Database.testPermission.

StoragePgDB.testPermission runs the supplied operation inside withTransaction, deliberately throws its dedicated TestPermissionRollbackError, and returns the operation result only after that deliberate rollback. Other exceptions propagate.

coverage: Successful probe rolls back and cannot make the clip ready
Absent or different operation, ordinary roles, non-probe version and nonempty metadata are denied
Wrong owner/session/lease and unrequested assets are denied
Revoked Auth session, paused worker gate, expired lease and removed recording rights are denied
Actual signed upload still requires complete provenance; UPDATE cannot enter the exception
Existing completion, publication, revocation, erasure and private-audience cases remain passing
verification.actual_post_fix_renderer_acceptance: Pending parent operator receipt; not inferred from local tests or migration apply.
